title: Rap Metal
style: Chinese Epic Rock, Power Metal, Shaanxi Opera, Dramatic, Energetic, Viral, National Trend (中国风史诗摇滚,力量金属,秦腔,戏剧性,充满活力,病毒式传播,国潮)
lyrics:
[Instrumental Introduction: Powerful drum kit and bass rhythms accompanied by towering suona and flute melodies]

[Section 1: The energetic suona and erhu lead the melody to the accompaniment of bass and drum kit

[Chorus: The melody shifts to a more heroic theme, with the flute and erhu interacting.]

[Chorus: Complete Collection.] The suona, erhu and flute played a grand ode. The drum set and bass provide a powerful, driving rhythm. Epic and inspiring.

[Section Two: The erhu takes the lead in responding with the suona. The bass and drums maintain a tight and energetic rhythm.]"

[Chorus: Another complete collection.] Even more powerful and more layered.

[Bridge: The melodious erhu and flute duet in a suspenseful bass and dramatic drum kit sound, creating vitality.]"

Guitar solo: Actually, it's "electric erhu and bass solo". The erhu plays a fast, melodious and powerful solo, accompanied by a light bass line and a vibrant drum kit sound.

[The final chorus: Play with all your might.] All the Musical Instruments were playing the national anthem powerfully.

[Narrator: With the final powerful note of the collision between the suona and the drum kit, the music gradually fades away.]
[Verse 1: Sun Wukong]
灵山脚下刚下班,佛祖给我新任务单
说这方世界太缭乱,好歌好剧看得人心烦
AI生成万花筒,光怪陆离挺像样
可咋就缺了点儿魂,打动不了你心肠?
就像那蟠桃没滋味,老孙我看着都急得慌!

[Pre-Chorus: Tang Sanzang]
真经不在西天,在心间
美感不该杂乱,如云烟
我们要汇聚,古今的英贤!

[Chorus: All]
千英盟!集结!为破这虚妄! (Hey!)
千英盟!开创!为音乐和梦想! (Let's go!)
给你视觉的盛宴,听觉的狂欢!
让每一次心跳,都跟着节奏震撼!
千英盟!来了!为每一个你!

[Verse 2: Zhu Bajie & Sha Wujing]
(Zhu Bajie)
别再刷那,千篇一律的尴尬段子啦!
来这看老猪,吹一段唢呐送你上青云!
李白负责写词,猴哥负责炸场子!
(Sha Wujing)
大师兄负责邀约,师父他把关
我打好这架子鼓,节奏不会乱
咱这联盟的出品,保准是精品!

[Chorus: All]
千英盟!集结!为破这虚妄! (Watch this!)
千英盟!开创!为音乐和梦想! (Awesome!)
给你视觉的盛宴,听觉的狂欢!
让每一次心跳,都跟着节奏震撼!
千英盟!来了!为每一个你!

[Bridge: Xiao Bailong]
不只是看客,你也是英雄
拿出你的才华,与我们相拥
这大千世界,由你我共同造梦...

[Guitar Solo]
(Electric Erhu and Bass solo, powerful and melodic)

[Final Chorus: All]
千英盟!为你!再造新传奇!
千英盟!在此!呼唤真心意!
告别那杂乱,告别那空虚!
加入这联盟,把快乐都重启!
千英盟!万岁!为了真与美!

[Outro: All]
(Music fades with last powerful notes)
谢谢各位老铁!点赞!关注!我们下期见!
